name: Martonyi (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of blue triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Martonyi: a blue shield with a yellow bunch of grapes, an arm, ears of grain and a sun, above a scroll inscribed MARTONYI.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
